The text **'Select a chat before marking it unread.'** is located in the **bottom bar** (specifically, a notification bar at the very bottom of the main content area). 

It is surrounded by:
*   **Above it:** The text input field (composer) with the placeholder "Ask Codex to change, inspect, or explain...".
*   **To its right:** A "Dismiss" button.
*   **Below it:** The outer edge/border of the application window.

The text in the **bottom-left footer** (of the sidebar) is: **Connection failed** (followed by a refresh icon).
